content: alexcrichton removed the review request for wasmtime-default-reviewers from PR #15328.

alexcrichton opened PR #15328 from alexcrichton:gh-actions-lock-files to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit was generated with

gh actions-lock --migrate-local-actions

and apparently uses: ./... is basically deprecated now in favor of uses: $/... because the former uses the checked-out state and the latter uses the pristine state of the checkout.

The repo doesn't require lock files just yet, but once this lands and is backported to all our branches we should be able to turn that on.
